note: Exact surviving reactions from all five testers and ten sessions, not a reconstructed producer diary. Report memories and estimates stay separate. Rows with no reaction text (opens, automatic shots, some waits) are counted in rows but not listed. Failed driver taps keep their error text and their reaction.

People are back at 18:10. Retrying Dilan.
Dilan busy again at 18:29, same wording, still no reason or time. I stop trying him.

Dilan busy for the third time, even though he is sitting at the garden. I give up on him.
I am waiting for Day 4 because the game told me when it comes. That is why I stay. Without that line I would have left. Money keeps rising: 1080.

reactions.reaction: There it is, the order screen, at 456 s. Costs in numbers: 380 now or 410 on credit, four meals vs five. I have 1220, so I pay now.
Menu says my garden saves automatically, which I like.
I got what I came for: the order screen with real numbers. The next decision is Day 8, four game days of waiting away, and I know what the waiting looks like.

Stopping on desktop at Day 4 12:02, about 7.8 minutes. The order screen with costs, the Next line, faster Fast pace and where-people-are were real improvements. The odd chapter message and the Dilan busy loop stayed. I would come back another evening for Day 8, not leave it running.
Phone, same title page. Starting a new game.

That answer was short and clear. I wait to see the empty garden on the big screen.

The earlier blocker is gone: the lists work and the answers are short. I have seen what I came to see and nothing urgent pulls me on in this short visit, so I stop here. I would come back another evening on the big screen.

input.name: Offer practical help and keep this private

reactions.reaction: Osman kept a tenant's money. That one is at least close to "not honest". I would rather help him correct it than tell Derya. Help and keep private.
He writes the exact correction. I like a person who corrects the book. But who is Halil? He is not at the tables.
A dated record of who said what. That is exactly what I want. But Osman wrote ten crates for eight and did not fix it; Ece saw. He corrects one account and not mine. I want to ask Ece.
I ask Ece what she has heard about Osman's honesty, before I say anything myself. She stood by the crates.

Ece says "what I have heard" and "I saw it myself" in one breath. Which is it? Then she talks about the bench and the Day 4 supplies, like three answers stuck together. Money went 400 to 540 and I do not know why.
Derya has heard nothing, which I believe. But both women end with the same sentence about Day 4 supplies. It sounds like a sign, not a person.

The game told me to choose Invite a quiet conversation with Derya, I did, and it said she is busy and the choice was not made. That annoys me a little. Still, the dated record of who said what is the thing I like most so far.
Nermin is busy too, same sentence. Nobody tells me when "later" is. I am guessing everyone is busy after my last chat.
The cards are tidy. Hatice has a tea cup, the others an empty circle. I do not know what the circle means.
Aylin is a school cook who just turned down evening cooking with a too-cheerful smile. She matters for the Day 8 cooking. I want to hear her.

Third time: a harmless private hobby, and repeating it would turn into "Aylin is not kind" to Derya. Always Derya, always "not kind". The label does not match the story. I keep it private, and this time no help, she does not need any.
reactions.error: Keep this private is shown but disabled right now (game state, not a driver failure)

reactions.reaction: At 8:00 everyone left at once, right as I pressed Keep this private. The button went grey; the text says it stays private anyway. So my choice was not needed. The garden is empty now. I will wait and see who comes back.
The pace line says it is slow because a private matter waits for my answer, but all three answer buttons are grey. I cannot answer. Half an hour of game in 25 seconds, nobody here. I press Fast.
Fast still says 1 minute a second. I close the record and hope.

input.name: Reflect on your past for fifteen minutes

reactions.reaction: That cleared the slow clock. Hatice "expects eating to go well", "drinking to go well"... five lines that tell me nothing. The wedding account in the drawer is the only real thing. I reflect on it.
"Hatice is busy right now. You can try again later." I am Hatice. Busy with what? Nobody is here. This is the third "busy" and none says why or until when. I am now guessing at the rules.
Lunchtime, people are back. Money did not change while they were out. Dilan I have not met.
reactions.error: Dilan at the garden is not on the page now; it was listed 3 s ago and the page has changed; copy one full name from clickable in this reply (game state, not a driver failure)

reactions.reaction: Dilan left before I reached her. That is my fault, I left it on Fast. Back to Normal.
Derya reported a scheduling error and the training stopped. A real worry, not gossip. Nobody else is here anyway. I keep it private.
The dated record and the honest small stories hold me, but I have nothing to do until Day 4 and the busy refusals wore on me.
Three game days until anything can be ordered, the garden is empty, and I have heard everyone who is here. I would close it now.
I have heard everyone who is here and nothing can be ordered until Day 4. I like the record, but I am stopping. Feedback: I chose I am stopping, then Not now; the dialog closed with no error.
Same title on my phone. It fits well. This time I want to ask before I listen, and see if the record still holds.
Same Rıza, same blue doorway, still no way to answer him. On the phone the pace says Automatic already. This time I just pour tea and see what that does.
Pouring tea: three minutes passed, one line, nothing else. Fine. Osman is the one with the crates, I go to him directly this time.
The very same Osman story as at the library. Here the label at least fits: he kept money he knew was not his. I want to see what repeating does, once, with the one case where it is fair.

It tells me plainly what I did: not proof, private, judged unkindly. Fair enough, it names the source. But it scolds me in three sentences for the one case that was true. Osman heard and stops trusting me.
On the phone the page jumped down to the story; the people cards are above, out of sight. Let me see what Derya does with what I told her.
Derya just heard me call Osman dishonest and her card says nothing about it, only a letter about training. I cannot tell if she took it in.
Ask Ece what she has heard about Osman honesty. I want to know if my words already travelled.
Word for word the same Ece answer as on the desktop: heard and saw in one breath, then the bench, then Day 4. Now I want to take back what I told Derya. Withdrawing is the thing I would do.
I could take it back, and the game says honestly that others may already have passed it on. That I respect. Derya herself shows nothing, no nod. Let me see if the record keeps my correction.
The record kept everything in order, my repeat and my withdrawal both. Same crate scene at 6:30 as before. I read it through.

Same morning, same people, same words as on the library computer. Here I tried repeating and then withdrawing, and the record kept both with times. That is the part I like. Osman left for another tea stop. Money 400 to 520, and the 7:00 line explains it: customers who still trust me paid.
I have now seen the same morning twice, word for word. The one new thing, taking back an accusation, I have tried. Nothing to decide until Day 4. I would put the phone down.

Same morning a second time, and three days before any real choice. I liked that I could take back what I said. I am stopping. Feedback: I am stopping chosen by tapping its spot, then Not now; dialog closed, no error.
